summary: scv-ui tests take 29s due to actual audio synthesis and playback. Main slow tests: CachedSynthesizerTests (8.3s), BackgroundPlayerView Tests (7.7s), SynthesizerPerformanceTests (3.9s). Tests use temporary directories to force synthesis with no cache hits. Each test synthesizes 9 segments. Consider: 1) Use mocks for unit tests, 2) Keep integration tests but optimize, 3) Cache synthesis results across tests, 4) Parallelize where safe.
